observations.purpose: Backend restart and cold-process requests; not detection accuracy

resource_boundary: Summaries of the largest observed sample in each trial, not exact peaks. Cgroup memory includes process/cache accounting; GPU memory is whole-device, not isolated application allocation.
timing_boundary: First POST after backend restart/readiness to image response or first completed video status poll. Seeds, restart and saved-recovery reads excluded; host caches not cleared.
limitations: Three observations per scenario; empirical p95 is the maximum, not a reliable tail estimate.
Not an accuracy evaluation or proof against every future restart failure.
Earlier failed attempt remains separate and unchanged.
